title: Warm Hybrid Axion Inflation in $α$-Attractor Models Constrained by ACT and Future Plan experiments
summary: We present a comprehensive study of warm hybrid inflation within the framework of $α$-attractor models, where an axionic inflaton is coupled to a waterfall field in the presence of thermal dissipation. The model is analyzed for both linear ($Υ\propto T$) and cubic ($Υ\propto T^{3}$) dissipation regimes.
